reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Review from a first year student.

review_content.Placements: 70-80 percent of students are placed from my course. The highest package is around 12 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA-3 LPA. Microsoft, Dell, Amazon, etc., are recruiting companies. 85-90 percent of students got internships with top recruiters like Accenture, Amazon, IBM, as software engineer, data analysts, and full-stack developers.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi-enabled smart classrooms, advanced labs, supported by a large library with centralised air-conditioners, 24/7 power backup, hostels with attached bathrooms, a health centre inside the campus, sports complex with pool, gym with multiple activities room.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure, a worthy off-campus view, knowledgeable faculty members, and average placements

review_content.Placements: I am currently in my 5th semester of B.Tech (CSE), and the most recent pass-out 2025 batch are placed in reputed companies. In our 5th semester, recently a US healthcare company, Vivnovation, visited offering ₹15,000 per month as an intern role and a PPO of 22 LPA on satisfactory work performance. This year, the 2025 pass-out percentage of students placed stood at 76.5%, with 268 getting placed out of 350. The highest in-campus package offer is by Amazon, PwC, and Microsoft, which are 14 LPA, 12 LPA, and 8 LPA respectively. The roles are SAP Consultant and TS.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Computer Science (AI and IoT) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: All-around campus with good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: Currently B.Sc. Computer Science (specialized in AI and IoT) is a newly formed branch that comes under the electronics and communication department, and I am the first batch student of this course. Placement is not initiated as we are currently in the second year of this course.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and faculty are good. Many facilities are provided by the department as well as the college. We can do whatever project we want to perform, and our department supports our projects and needs. Wi-Fi quality is a bit disappointing on campus, almost everyone uses 5G in college because Jio 5G has very high internet speed on campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Sikkim Manipal Institute of Technology.

review_content.Placements: Around 70% of students are placed in B.Tech CSE, which is approximately 100 to 150 students. The highest package for B.Tech CSE is around 25 LPA, and the lowest is around 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Dell, Microsoft, Amazon, Flipkart, and many more. Almost all students from the B.Tech CSE department secure jobs and internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: SMIT has six academic blocks, including labs, workshops, a library, and reading rooms. Besides this, it also has two hostels, one for boys and one for girls. The campus includes one ground and a sports block with a swimming facility. The hostel facilities are good, with each room accommodating two students and a floor warden assigned to each floor. The food in the mess is also good.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: The college is good, you get good education, and can live a college life.

review_content.Placements: The package in our college is like 3 to 4 Lacs per year, which is an average package for a beginner, and it is good to start with it. Many companies offer here, such as HDFC, Occitan, etc. 79 percent of the students get jobs, and they get the post of human resources manager.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. The college has many buildings and has a playground. All facilities are available. The hostel is also very big the hostel rooms are spacious and hygienic. There is a marina where there is good food and indoor games, a gym, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Mathematics - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: I am happy with my decision to join college as it is better than my expectations.

review_content.Placements: The college is overall good for me. Students in our batch are less than 15. We usually get offers for internships from the 3rd year. I am currently in my 2nd year, I can't say anything about placements. After completing B.Sc. in mathematics, students get many options in different sectors like business, banking, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college provides facilities and infrastructure. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Students can go to the library for studies. Classrooms are well-maintained. There are labs for every department. In the hostel, students get two choices to stay one for single and one for double. Students get a gym, a swimming pool, and an indoor court for basketball and badminton. Students can use an outdoor court as their choice.

review_summary.college_name: SMIT Sikkim Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Review from a first year student.

content.Placements: 70-80 percent of students are placed from my course. The highest package is around 12 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA-3 LPA. Microsoft, Dell, Amazon, etc., are recruiting companies. 85-90 percent of students got internships with top recruiters like Accenture, Amazon, IBM, as software engineer, data analysts, and full-stack developers.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi-enabled smart classrooms, advanced labs, supported by a large library with centralised air-conditioners, 24/7 power backup, hostels with attached bathrooms, a health centre inside the campus, sports complex with pool, gym with multiple activities room.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, a worthy off-campus view, knowledgeable faculty members, and average placements

content.Placements: I am currently in my 5th semester of B.Tech (CSE), and the most recent pass-out 2025 batch are placed in reputed companies. In our 5th semester, recently a US healthcare company, Vivnovation, visited offering ₹15,000 per month as an intern role and a PPO of 22 LPA on satisfactory work performance. This year, the 2025 pass-out percentage of students placed stood at 76.5%, with 268 getting placed out of 350. The highest in-campus package offer is by Amazon, PwC, and Microsoft, which are 14 LPA, 12 LPA, and 8 LPA respectively. The roles are SAP Consultant and TS.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Computer Science (AI and IoT) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: All-around campus with good infrastructure.

content.Placements: Currently B.Sc. Computer Science (specialized in AI and IoT) is a newly formed branch that comes under the electronics and communication department, and I am the first batch student of this course. Placement is not initiated as we are currently in the second year of this course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and faculty are good. Many facilities are provided by the department as well as the college. We can do whatever project we want to perform, and our department supports our projects and needs. Wi-Fi quality is a bit disappointing on campus, almost everyone uses 5G in college because Jio 5G has very high internet speed on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Sikkim Manipal Institute of Technology.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students are placed in B.Tech CSE, which is approximately 100 to 150 students. The highest package for B.Tech CSE is around 25 LPA, and the lowest is around 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Dell, Microsoft, Amazon, Flipkart, and many more. Almost all students from the B.Tech CSE department secure jobs and internships.
content.Infrastructure: SMIT has six academic blocks, including labs, workshops, a library, and reading rooms. Besides this, it also has two hostels, one for boys and one for girls. The campus includes one ground and a sports block with a swimming facility. The hostel facilities are good, with each room accommodating two students and a floor warden assigned to each floor. The food in the mess is also good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college is good, you get good education, and can live a college life.

content.Placements: The package in our college is like 3 to 4 Lacs per year, which is an average package for a beginner, and it is good to start with it. Many companies offer here, such as HDFC, Occitan, etc. 79 percent of the students get jobs, and they get the post of human resources manager.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. The college has many buildings and has a playground. All facilities are available. The hostel is also very big the hostel rooms are spacious and hygienic. There is a marina where there is good food and indoor games, a gym, etc.

faqs.question: How do I get into SMIT Sikkim?
faqs.answer: To get admission into SMIT Sikkim, first check the eligibility criteria for your desired course because some of the admissions are based on merit and others entrance-based. Apply online through the official website of Sikkim Manipal University. The applications are usually opened in November. Candidates are shortlisted based on scores obtained in national-level entrance exams like JEE Main, NET, CAT, or MAT. For those candidates who do not have scores from such exams, SMIT conducts its entrance exam. In addition to GDPI, an MBA aspirant has to go through Group Discussion and Personal Interview. On getting shortlisted, they have to pay the admission fee to reserve the seat.

faqs.question: I have scored 60% in Class 12. Am I eligible to get admissions into BBA course at SMIT, Sikkim Manipal University?
faqs.answer: The basic eligibility criteria required for admissions to the BBA course at SMIT, Sikkim Manipal University, is that candidates must complete their Class 12 in any stream with at least an aggregate of 50% marks. If candidates have secured 60% in their Class 12, they are eligible to enroll in the course, and there is a chance that they will get admission.However, this is not definite if the candidate has secured 60% in their Class 12, so they will definitely get admission to the BCA course. Because the admission is based on merit, and the institute offers a limited number of seats. Hence, there is a chance that candidates with higher scores will fill the seats of the BCA course.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, a worthy off-campus view, knowledgeable faculty members, and average placements
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are well-equipped with proper seating arrangements and basic facilities. Every classroom is a smart class (no A/C). The labs are all Wi-Fi enabled with modern computers and architecture (A/C enabled). The library is big, well maintained, and has a large collection of books and reading space. Extra books can be provided on demand. Basic hostel facilities include bed, mattress, pillow, and bathroom items. Every room has average Wi-Fi with 16 Mbps speed. Mess food quality is low and ...

reviews.review_heading: All-around campus with good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and faculty are good. Many facilities are provided by the department as well as the college. We can do whatever project we want to perform, and our department supports our projects and needs. Wi-Fi quality is a bit disappointing on campus, almost everyone uses 5G in college because Jio 5G has very high internet speed on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sikkim Manipal Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: SMIT has six academic blocks, including labs, workshops, a library, and reading rooms. Besides this, it also has two hostels, one for boys and one for girls. The campus includes one ground and a sports block with a swimming facility. The hostel facilities are good, with each room accommodating two students and a floor warden assigned to each floor. The food in the mess is also good.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, you get good education, and can live a college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. The college has many buildings and has a playground. All facilities are available. The hostel is also very big the hostel rooms are spacious and hygienic. There is a marina where there is good food and indoor games, a gym, etc.

reviews.review_heading: I am happy with my decision to join college as it is better than my expectations.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides facilities and infrastructure. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Students can go to the library for studies. Classrooms are well-maintained. There are labs for every department. In the hostel, students get two choices to stay one for single and one for double. Students get a gym, a swimming pool, and an indoor court for basketball and badminton. Students can use an outdoor court as their choice.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college experience was okay for me. Someone who wants to explore nearby locations.
reviews.review_text: The course is outdated and many of the PPTs are too old, and the same PPT is used to teach us with a few minor changes. We weren't provided with any industry visits. New teachers were nice and put effort into teaching. The hostel was fine, clean, and well-maintained. The lift was not serviced on a timely basis, but it was okay for me.

reviews.review_heading: A short summary of Sikkim Manipal Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Amidst the beautiful valleys of Sikkim, we have this college situated, which provides the perfect ambiance for studies. The hostels are quite decent compared to other colleges, and the main advantage is having personal bathrooms. The quality of food in the mess is also good, where a diverse menu is followed.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, but there is no outside life, like no markets or malls.
reviews.review_text: Honestly, the facilities and infrastructure available in this college are very nice. The whole campus has Wi-Fi, there are 4-5 lab rooms, and the classrooms are also very nice. There is a library with a reading hall, and it is quite spacious and air-conditioned. Regarding the hostel, they provide a night canteen. The quality of food in the mess is quite good; you can eat there, and they serve different meals each day. They have a weekly meal chart, and there is a dispensary for any medical issue...

reviews.review_heading: Life at Smit - an experience.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms at SMIT are big, wide, and spacious, and they are also clean. The Wi-Fi is very fast. The library is chilled and spacious, and it offers a large range of books, from mathematics to chemistry to physics. Many project files and research papers are also available, along with an e-library.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college in terms of faculty and placements.
reviews.review_text: The facility provided in terms of infrastructure and course is great overall, equipped with industry-demand course curriculum. They provide facilities for a digital library and good internet connectivity. The food provided is decent for students from different regions.

reviews.review_heading: Education in the mountains.
reviews.review_text: Courses available in the college consist of skill-based subjects which make the students work hard to excel in every field. The topics which are covered in this course are up to the mark. Hostel life here is also very exciting with a strong Wi-Fi connection and continuous supply of electricity and water.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely amazing and worth remembering experience.
reviews.review_text:
The hostel at SMIT, like any other college, is pretty decent. It has Wi-Fi facilities not just inside the hostel but throughout the entire campus.
The hostel rooms are of 4 different types: double- or single-room, with or without AC, and have facilities like a sports gym, a medical service, library and different kinds of workshops and laboratories.

reviews.review_heading: Short and honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: According to the hills, infrastructure is quite good. Hostels are far better than the other colleges. There is a well-maintained library and a separate reading hall for students. Wi-Fi connection is very bad; you have to use your own data. Labs are okay.

reviews.review_heading: Total experience and review by an ex student.
reviews.review_text: The hostel provides Wi-Fi, along with various facilities such as classrooms, playgrounds for cricket and football, a complex with a gym, snooker, table tennis, basketball court, auditorium, and a food court. Additionally, there is a swimming pool, amphitheater hall, court, library with a stationary shop, and a dispensary for health issues.

overview_faqs.answer: Silicon Institute of Technology in Bhubaneswar is generally a good college, particularly with respect to the placements and faculty. The placement record of the college is pretty good with average packages ranging between INR 4 to 6 lakhs per annum and the highest package till date was somewhere around 32 lakhs per annum. Reviews, however, do reflect that infrastructure is lacking in a few of them. On the whole, however, the Silicon Institute of Technology is very much a decent institution where a student can take engineering studies. It is more favourable towards the engineering streams with respect to its training of students according to industry requirements.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at Silicon Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar?
faqs.answer: Yes, direct admission is available at Silicon Institute of Technology (SIT) Bhubaneswar for certain categories of students, primarily through the Management Quota. Students who do not qualify through the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) or the Odisha Joint Entrance Examination (OJEE) may still apply for management quota seats.

faqs.question: What entrance exam scores are accepted by Silicon Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar for admission M.Tech.?
faqs.answer: For admission to its M.Tech programs, Silicon Institute of Technology, Bhubaneswar, recognizes legitimate entrance exam results. Scores that match legitimate GATE, OJEE, and/or OJEE PGAT scores are regarded as accepted. CUET-PG scores are also accepted for admissions purposes. Following their selection based on those results, candidates will be given consideration for counseling in order to be assigned a seat. With an emphasis on both theoretical and practical skills in engineering and technology, the two-year M.Tech programme provides a variety of postgraduate specializations.

faqs.question: Is it easy to get admission in Silicon Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar?
faqs.answer: Admission to the Silicon Institute of Technology, Bhubaneswar is relatively less problematic, mainly on the basis of rank acquired in OJEE or JEE Main. Candidates must have cleared Class 12 with subjects like Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Biology. Selection for admission is through online registration as well as counseling conducted by OJEE. Although this is merit-based, the competition varies from branch to branch. As a whole, however, it is accessible, but the rank needed to secure a seat has to be met.

faqs.question: What entrance exams are accepted by Silicon Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar for admission to B.Tech.?
faqs.answer: The admission to the B.Tech programs in Silicon Institute of Technology, Bhubaneswar, is through scores generated from the JEE Main and OJEE, the Odisha Joint Entrance Examination. Thereby, only good performances at these entrance tests would make students eligible for counseling and seat allotment. It emphasizes merit-based admission; only competitive examinations of these institutions supported students' selections. Admission also involves the counseling process conducted under OJEE, which makes the final choice of candidates for various engineering specializations presented at the institute.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure of hostels and classrooms, and clean surroundings.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very good and you can enjoy a lot. Free Wi-Fi is also available, and you can gain a lot of knowledge. The library is also there, which is a very peaceful and silent place where you can read books, and there are many magazines, so you can learn a lot.

reviews.review_heading: Strict about academics and good placement record.
reviews.review_text: The campus is small, and the infrastructure is good according to the campus size. Hostel rooms are clean and spacious.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty and good placements from 2019, but not good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi in the hostel but in some classrooms it is available. Hostel has AC and also non-AC rooms, a water cooler, washing machines, network routers, water heaters, etc. The quality of the mess and canteen food is not the best but good compared to other colleges. Doctors are available in the hostel for 1-2 days per week. Badminton courts are available in all hostels and other courts are available outside the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: The disciplined environment and focus on students.
reviews.review_text: Great infrastructure, with advanced equipment available for students in every laboratory. Hostels provide clean and hygienic food and washroom facilities. Our food menu is decided by students which is an extraordinary feature for students of Silicon. The campus is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi. Hostels provide comfortable accommodation with necessary amenities. However, some students have suggested improvements in medical facilities and food quality in the mess and canteen.

reviews.review_heading: A value for money, a return on investment, a strict, disciplined, and academically strong college.
reviews.review_text: The campus is small, with limited facilities in a small area. The authorities are strict, with strict rules. There is less campus life, and not many events take place. On a small campus, you do not know what you will enjoy. There are very few events and a smaller crowd, which can be good and bad. There is less social exposure, as students from other colleges don’t visit often. Although the campus is lush green, it is clean.

reviews.review_heading: As I invested more so, I got that much more. That is a placement that everyone needs.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. Well-equipped classrooms and labs are there for us. Each classroom has Wi-Fi installed, so there are no interruptions in the network. The library area is very calm and a proper environment for studying, with AC and non-AC rooms available as per the needs of students, along with Wi-Fi. Our hostels, for both boys and girls, have clean and hygienic rooms, corridors, and washrooms. Water and electricity are available 24/7. A lift is also installed, as ...

reviews.review_heading: My college life at Silicon university.
reviews.review_text: The college has nice infrastructure but the campus is \small or else the campus environment is so good. We have a central library and a Skylab where students can access free Wi-Fi. We have different academic buildings for computer science and engineering, electronics and communication engineering, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, facilities, and studies.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are quite good. Hostel facilities are amazing, as many of my friends live in the hostel. The college organizes many events and sports for students to participate in and gain knowledge from. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Silicon University - Do join for studies and memories.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi in the hostel, but it is available in the library, some classrooms, and Skylab. Food is average in the hostel. There are great opportunities for sports and games. College also has medical facilities. If you don't wish to eat in the canteen you can eat at the cafeteria.

reviews.review_heading: Silicon Institute is a good institute with a comfortable environment.
reviews.review_text: The hostel structure is pretty good with a lot of facilities like a gym, sports ground, etc. There are two types of hostels, One is AC and the other one is non-AC, and we can choose as we like. Wi-Fi is available everywhere and we can access it. Labs are quite good with well-managed desks and chairs. We can run our computer there. Classrooms are neat and clean. In the summer season, we get AC classrooms. Labs are good and have every equipment we need.

reviews.review_heading: A great place to learn about life, and you will grow as a human in this place.
reviews.review_text: Everything was available. Facilities were good. Hostel rooms were good, and you will enjoy them. Sports complex was there, focus on studies, and everything else was gonna be alright. Gym and other amenities were also available. Go for it, and it was worth it. I would recommend this to everyone. Sports were good and other clubs were nice.

reviews.review_heading: An amazing university where career is crafted.
reviews.review_text: College has a nice infrastructure with Wi-Fi connectivity throughout the campus and smart labs. Classrooms are also great in every aspect. College has a big common library for the students where there are various books to read and to do research about.

reviews.review_heading: Silicon University: A comprehensive review of education and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of Silicon is modern and as per the needs of students. Campus has labs in various engineering departments. Classrooms are spacious. There is a dedicated exam hall, training hall, skill development, and many more. The college library is well stocked by good collection of books, research papers, and journals. Free Wi-Fi is available on campus. Two canteens, serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, and one cafeteria are available on campus. Food quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, facility and studies.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are excellent in the college. I think it lacks medical facilities; other than that, it is amazing. The facilities in the hostel are amazing, but the quality of food available in the mess and canteen can be improved. The infrastructure for sports and games is very good.

reviews.review_heading: This is a very good place to groom a person and bring the best out of them to build a future.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms comprise both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned rooms with projectors. The library is quite spacious and has cubicle seating along with discussion rooms for group discussions. More than 50 laboratories are available along with free Wi-Fi in almost all regions. The hostel has both AC and non-AC rooms and separate veg and non-veg canteens for food, along with four dining halls.

overview_faqs.question: What is TANCET application fee? Do reserved categories have any fee concessions?
overview_faqs.answer: TANCET application fee may or may not change across exam sessions. The application fee for TANCET was revised previously. Earlier, candidates had to pay INR 400 if they belonged to reserved categories and INR 800 if they belonged to unreserved categories. However, the fee for all categories was hiked. Unreserved categories had to pay INR 1000 and INR 500, respectively. Since the exam fees was revised in the recent session, Anna University is unlikely to change the same again. However, the application details along with the TANCET registration fee is to release soon.

individual_reviews.title: SECE is the best for good placements from the beginning and eco-friendly surroundings.

content.Placements: In our batch of 2023, around 300 students, almost 280 students got placed in well-known companies with good packages. content.Infrastructure: There were lots of facilities available in our department. Most preferably, I would say the library, which was useful for all final-year and project-delivering students. Almost all areas of the college and hostels had Wi-Fi. There were separate labs for ECE, EEE, CSE, IT, and Mech. Facilities in the college hostel were good, and the food quality was also good. There was a separate roof for medical facilities called the medical center. There were enough sports and games facilities for both day scholars and hostellers to play. More tournaments were held for sports and games.

reviews.review_text: There were lots of facilities available in our department. Most preferably, I would say the library, which was useful for all final-year and project-delivering students. There was a separate roof for medical facilities called the medical center. There were enough sports and games facilities for both day sc...

reviews.review_heading: Good placement with 100%, best infrastructure, qualified faculty.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure in our college are really good and developed, Classrooms are well-modified within today's version with smartboards. 24/7 availability of Wi-Fi in both hostel as well as college is there. The hostel in the college will be much more comfortable like a 5-star hotel with a separate cot with a free pillow and bedsheet. The food in the hostel has very good quality. It is healthy.

reviews.review_heading: A growth full college life in my 20's.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is very good and green. We have more than 20 labs for every domain in our college. Hostel is good and maintained in a neat way which is cleaned daily. Hostel food is okay. We too have mario and canteen inside our college where we can have snacks whenever needed.

reviews.review_heading: The over-hyped college in Coimbatore SECE.
reviews.review_text: The overall building is a little decent, but there is a signal to make calls. Wi-Fi is not strong enough when there are more than 40 devices connected to the Wi-Fi. This is not a good count when there is only 1 repeater per class. Each class has over 60 students. Some of us have to rely on our personal hotspot, which is also bad due to the poor signal.

reviews.review_heading: Life at Sri Eshwar College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Really good infrastructure. Other than classrooms, more labs and IT centers are present here. A library is also here with every book. Unlimited free Wi-Fi is available, as every class has smart boards. The hostel was very good here. It is more comfortable and safe. Food provided here is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Honest review about life at Sri Eshwar.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have Wi-Fi, have charging ports for every bench, and have smartboards for interactive classes. A medical center is available. Hostel mess provides average food and there are few canteens inside campus with good food. Hostel rooms have all needed furniture, like a bed, study table, cupboards and Wi-Fi is available.

reviews.review_heading: Good, Bad, Ugly - A Review on SECE
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good overall. However, the Wi-Fi in the labs is often slow, and the classrooms are somewhat outdated. The library is well-equipped, and there are many sports facilities; our college has won numerous trophies. The canteen food is also quite good.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with scholarship for merits.
reviews.review_text: There are many labs in college , but the network in college is very bad you won't get good network since the college is in village.The food available in college is good and affordable.The hostel food is also good .The are few facilities for sports but not much encouraged.There is a medical center inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Sri Eshwar College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: It's a better, stress-free campus. We are strictly asked to follow the principles insisted upon by the college to maintain a healthy environment. Our canteen serves all kinds of snacks, breakfast, lunch, and specific recipes followed every single day.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sri Eshwar College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure with new buildings. Classrooms are spacious and well ventilated. Equipped with a projector and white box. Good Wi-Fi connection, but slow internet through Sim. The climate will be pleasant, and hot water will be available for bathing. Labs are available.

reviews.review_heading: My engineering college review.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very moderate. The labs are up to date and the classrooms have Wi-Fi connections and a smart board. Libraries have a wide range of technical books. There is a medical centre that has many facilities. There is a cafe, Mario, and plenty of food.

reviews.review_heading: Exceptional Satisfaction: Achieving Success with Top Faculty & high placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is awesome. Wi-Fi is enabled for the whole campus. The infrastructure of the hostel is also well and good. The food provided in the hostel mess is like home food. So no more worries about hostel food. The canteen food is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for students.
reviews.review_text: All over college surrounding has Wi-Fi facility. Hostel facility is available for both girls and boys. But some days the hostel food was insufficient for students. Eshwar college has very interesting labs and maker spaces to allow students to perform projects and improve their skills.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of placement in 2024.
reviews.review_text: Our college has well-equipped classrooms with smart boards and visual projectors, specialized labs for practical sessions, access to a library with relevant books, journals, and online resources. It also has common areas for socializing and studying in the hostel, on-site cafeteria, and access to medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Exceptional Faculty, Industry-Relevant, Supportive : Sri Eshwar College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: I wouldn't say that the infrastructure is too good, but it's not like it's bad also. It is optimal. But the only problem that our College has is, the signal issues. But it won't be a problem, as our College offers unlimited free high-speed Wi-fi to all the students. The food and hostel accommodation are too good to be true to be honest. When comparing to all other colleges, our college provides wonderful hostel accommodation at a reasonable price. We also have a exclusive medical center for stud...

admission_overview.description: Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering admissions 2025 are open. The college offers courses in the field of Engineering, including B.E., B.Tech, M.E., M.Tech, and PhD. These courses are offered under the affiliation with Anna University. Admissions to all the courses are administered by the Directorate of Technical Education. SVCE admission is completely entrance-based. The Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering accepts CET and TANCET scores for BTech and MTech courses, respectively. Further, direct admissions are also offered through Lateral Entry. paragraphs: Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering admissions are completely online. Candidates can go through the following steps for the detailed Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering admission process:
Step 1: Application Process

Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering applications are conducted in an online mode. Aspirants must visit the official website of the college to apply for their desired programme. The application form must be filled out with all the appropriate details regarding the educational and personal details. Along with that, they must also upload the relevant documents and pay the application fee before submitting the form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to all the UG & PG courses at SVCE is entrance-based. For UG courses, the college accepts scores of the Common Entrance Test (CET). Whereas, for PG courses, TANCET is mandatory to qualify. The admission process at SVCE is regulated by the Department of Technical Education, Government of Tamil Nadu and Anna University.
Step 3: Counselling Process

As per the admission norms, 50% seats for UG courses are filled up through the Tamil Nadu Government Department of Technical Education online counselling. Whereas, the remaining 50% of seats are filled through management quota, as per the Govt norms. For the Management quota, candidates must appear for the college-level counselling process.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure, helpful faculty, and placement training.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good infrastructure overall. Classrooms are spacious with projectors. Labs are well-equipped with updated systems and fast Wi-Fi. The library has a wide range of books and decent seating. Hostel facilities are average with shared rooms, but maintenance is regular. Food in the mess is hygienic, but the taste could be improved. The campus is clean and secure, with 24-hour security guards.

reviews.review_heading: All about SVCE Sriperumbudur.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are above average with decent infrastructure and we have projectors in all the classrooms. The library has a vast collection of books on 2 floors and Has AC in the reading hall, hostel food is mostly disliked by everyone. It is really worse other than that the hostel rooms are quite decent. And good sanitation places too. With proper cleaning. Students get 4 to 5 outpasses per month.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college to study.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure and facilities are acceptable. 
 Well-maintained labs for every department. 
Huge grounds and play areas and decent classrooms. 
This is a pure veg college and a kind of orthodox one.
More important for sports extracurricular activities will be appreciated.

reviews.review_heading: In Sri Venkateswara College, the whole campus environment is just like heaven.
reviews.review_text: The library of this college is good and they issue books to students for free.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, and life at SVCE is pretty easy and good.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi access inside the campus, and we need to fill a form in the 1st year of college. Classrooms and the library are well-maintained. The food at the canteen is good, but there aren't many varieties. There is also a food court where you can get food like noodles and fried rice.

reviews.review_heading: Good college to complete your engineering course.
reviews.review_text: My college infrastructure is good. Classrooms have projectors, and the college provides full WiFi facilities. The library is very high class, with over 100,000 books. The library has its own app that lets students check out books and see when they are due. My college has very high-tech labs, especially in my department, biotechnology. The hostel rooms and campus are great, but the food is not that great. The college has a lot of sports and games, with a special emphasis on cricket.

reviews.review_heading: A great campus amidst woods with great placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text:
The network seems to be a little problematic because of the high-voltage electricity cables across the campus, and we have a separate WiFi for our students. 
The food quality is a bit poor in the hostels, but the canteen food is great. And we have good medical facilities and a big ground for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college till now; really good infrastructure and a good environment.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good and sufficient for studying for four years, with no need for drastic changes in infrastructure. The canteen is good and cheap. The Wi-Fi facility is very good, and the department library, central library, and classrooms are well maintained. There is enough food for everybody in the mess and the canteen, and medical facilities are available 24/7. There are sports facilities including a tennis court, basketball court, cricket ground, football ground, swimming pool, and badminton...

reviews.review_heading: A good infrastructure college that prioritizes academic and general activities.
reviews.review_text:
Prepared food prices are decent and good in canteens.
But packed snacks and drinks are being sold at a bit higher price than the original price.
And I don't know much about hostels, as I'm a day scholar.
But from what I've heard, you get minimal variety, and taste is not up to mark. 
Also, this college is pure vegetarian.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure but poor hostel facilities; average placement but friendly campus .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in SVCE is one of the best in the state. Almost all labs are well-equipped but some can be quite old and lack new equipment. If you compare them with other colleges, then SVCE labs are quite good. The hostel might be the worst part, as the food, the quality of the rooms, and the and the hygiene are below average. Since non-vegetarian foods aren't allowed, the fee they charge for hostels is too high for vegetarian food with poor quality and taste, along with old rooms and beds....

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good in placement and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure was superb. Many courses are available at our college. Labs are always superb. Unlimited Wi-Fi is available on the college campus and hostel. And also available for staff. In my college library, there are more than a million books.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good.
reviews.review_text: First-year students should stay in a shared room. Each room has 2 fans, a table, and a cupboard. Second-year students got separate rooms. The menu is changed every 6 months. The food served in the hostel is very good. Hostel registration is done during the college admissions process. There are many apartments near our college. The hostel fee is Rs. 95,000 per year.

reviews.review_heading: Experience gives the pulse of campus life.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure are very good and perfect and project 
also done by our college with innovative. And our
college hostel was good it feel us to be comfort and gives pace for focus in the studies, sports etc. In our 
College each and every thing gives positive vibes to stay our college.

reviews.review_heading: This college is really good to find your dream.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in our department are very excellent. Facilities like classrooms, restrooms, playgrounds, and labs are highly good and neat to use. Labs are air-conditioned along with Wi-Fi. The library contains more than 2,00,000 books to read. The hostel food is very good and neat and hygienic. Medical facilities help immediately with any rescue.

reviews.review_heading: Very good placements in 2018.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided in the laboratories, classrooms, and department halls are very good. The speed of wi-fi is very good. Rooms in the hostel are very neat. The quality of food provided in the canteen/mess is good for non-veg eaters.

paragraphs: Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering and Technology, Chittoor admissionis a blend of merit and entrance basis. The college offers courses, such as BTech, MTech MCA and MBA at the UG and PG levels. Apart from the degree courses, the college also offers diploma courses. To get admitted toSVCET Chittoor, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the college. The college is affiliated withJawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Ananthapuramu. The college offers more than 10 courses in the Engineering and Computer Application streams. The application process at Sri VCET is conducted online. Read the following article to know more aboutSri Venkateswara College of Engineering and Technologycourse admission2025.

Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering and Technologyadmission 2025is entrance-based. The mode of study for SVCET courses is full-time. To enrol for various course admissions, candidates must complete the last educational qualification set by the college. Read on to know more aboutSri Venkateswara College of Engineering and Technologycourse admission2025.

SVCET course admissionsare based on entrance exam scores. Candidates must also fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements for the respective courses. To enroll in the UG courses offered at the college, students need to pass Class 12. Whereas, for PG admissions, students need to clear graduation in the relevant field. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection criteria forSri Venkateswara College of Engineering and Technology courses:
Class with a 50% aggregate with Mathematics, Physics & Chemistry as compulsory subjects
Merit/ Entrance-based + Counselling
BTech/BE with a 50% aggregate
Any degree with a 50% aggregate
APICETbased onICET rank
Any Degree with 50% aggregate with Mathematics Compulsory subject

Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering and Technology admission process includes registration and merit list preparation as per respective courses. Candidates must follow the below steps to get a seat in SVCET:
STEP 1: Application Process
Candidates are required to apply online at the institute's official website. Before applying, students are required to fulfil the admission criteria of the desired programme.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

Students will be selected based on merit and entrance exam scores as per respective courses. Students are selected based on the entrance exams. The college accepts state and national-level exams to shortlist the students in addition to considering candidate's academic performance.
STEP 3: Merit List andAdmission Confirmation
Once selection rounds are over, the institute releases a merit list. To confirm the seat candidates are required to pay theSVCET admission feeat the admission receipt centre.

individual_reviews.title: Totally good at all equipment and I am really satisfied in this college.

The placement faculty puts in good effort and regularly shares off-campus and pooled drive information. Around 40–50% of students from my course got placed. The highest package was around ₹6 LPA, the lowest about ₹2.5 LPA, and the average package stayed near ₹3–3.2 LPA. Companies like construction companies and other companies. Internships were also high.

faqs.question: Is MU - Mewar University good for placements?
faqs.answer: Located in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, Mewar University boasts a student-centric placement cell dedicated to aiding students in securing their desired employment opportunities. As per the latest data, the university has successfully placed over 600 students with an impressive average package of Rs. 4.2 LPA. Notable recruiters in 2023 included prominent names such as Wipro, TCS, Genpact, Lupin, ICICI Bank, and CEAT Tyres. The placement process involves essential steps like registering on the Campus Interaction Portal, engaging with recruiters for campus placements, completing the Employer Registration Form (ERF), and collaboratively determining dates for pre-placement talks and final placements. While the available information suggests a favorable placement record for Mewar University, it is advisable to conduct additional research and seek insights from alumni or current students for a comprehensive evaluation before making any decisions.

reviews.review_heading: Totally good at all equipment and I am really satisfied in this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure provided for our course is good. Many computers in the labs are working well, and the internet is also good at any time, which affects practical classes. Classrooms have digital boards, and all teachers are comfortable using them effectively. The library has a decent collection of books, but the space could be better maintained. Hostel facilities are manageable, the rooms are okay. The hostel food is simple and edible, though the menu does not change much. Medical support is a...

reviews.review_heading: SVCE is the best college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel has good infrastructure. They used to keep clean. They are used to play games in ground. The food is excellent and sometimes not nice. The tiffin is very good except on two days and the people are restricted to go out side without permission.

reviews.review_heading: The college's excellence in teaching.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is superb but the beds are up and down. The college has digital boards, and the facilities are good. It is conducting good CRT classes, and they are developing to the change of the college placements for improvement. They are good from their perspective.

reviews.review_heading: If you're willing to join SVCE, then you don't have to think twice because it's the best.
reviews.review_text: The hospitality and infrastructure are quite good among all other colleges that come under Tirupati. As we look into the facilities they're providing, every required facility that can make students feel comfortable and satisfy this college is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements were there last year.
reviews.review_text: The facilities that we have are poor Wi-Fi for classes, but Ethernet is available in labs, so no problem. Each classroom has dedicated digital boards, a good number of laboratories, well-managed classrooms and a sufficient number of libraries. The quality of facilities available in our hostel is the same as that of other hostels, with no special treatment. The quality of food is super, good games and sports, and there are some medical kits available.

reviews.review_heading: It is better than the past years.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is satisfied here. It provides well infrastructure and education. It recently added NCC for students, and conducted monthly technical events. It has well-equipped infrastructure labs with the latest updated versions and soft skills communication labs. There are electrical department labs that are fully equipped.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with quality teaching.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for my course and department are good. Wi-Fi is not provided to students. Labs and classrooms are spacious and good. The library is big, and there are many books available for my course. Hostel facilities and the canteen are average.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college in our city
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure in our college are very good. We have good Wi-Fi connections, very new computers, and very good library rooms. The hostel food is very hygienic, and the food is also good. The rooms are very clean, and there are good sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment with decent placements, strong academics.
reviews.review_text: Our department has Wi-Fi, equipped labs, smart classrooms, and a good library. Hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms, normal mess food, canteen snacks, basic medical support, and good sports grounds for games and fitness. Good environment.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied and good.
reviews.review_text: The ECE department has well-developed academic and technical facilities to support both theory and hands-on learning. ECE has fully equipped labs. These labs have oscilloscopes, signal generators, a trainer kit, sports, and monthly events are conducted.

reviews.review_heading: The ECE course is best, and my faculty is well-experienced and very friendly with students.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided in hostels are well-equipped. The rooms are cleaned every day. The canteen and mess food is very good and tasty.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with the industry-relevant IT course with good labs and supportive staff.
reviews.review_text: Internet speed is usually stable enough for coding, online labs, and project submissions. Labs are maintained regularly and have air-conditioning in most campuses. Many colleges provide smart classrooms with projectors, audio systems, and digital boards.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good and useful college.
reviews.review_text: Super and good facilities and infrastructure in our college. We have good speed Wi-Fi connections in our block and super-fast computer systems in labs. Library books are also good, and the facilities in our college are nice. Food is good, and the rooms are hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Very nice and beautiful college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our college are above average, and the infrastructure of our college/department is very good. We have very high-speed internet, good labs, updated systems, large classrooms, and good hostel rooms. Additionally, we have hygienic food.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and practical training in Cyber Security.
reviews.review_text: Our Cyber Security course had well-equipped labs with updated tools, high-speed Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and access to a good digital library. The hostel provided clean rooms, continuous water supply, and decent security. Mess food is average but hygienic and the canteen offered better options. Basic medical facilities are available on campus along with playgrounds, indoor games, and areas for fitness and recreation creating a comfortable overall living and learning environment.

review_summary.college_name: SVUCE Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering & Industrial Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Decent infrastructure and campus life, good faculty, and average placement.

content.Placements: The B.Tech Mechanical Engineering 2024 batch had a decent placement outcome, with about 70 percent of students placed. The highest package offered is 7 LPA, with a average package of 4.5 LPA. Core recruiters like L&T, Tata Motors, Mahindra, and Bosch hire for design, production, and quality roles.
content.Infrastructure: The department had well equipped mechanical labs, smart classrooms, campus Wi-Fi, and a good central library. Hostel facilities were decent with clean rooms. Mess food is average, and canteen options were available. Medical facilities and sports grounds support student well being and activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college. The college and hostel fees are affordable. We can't expect huge placements.

content.Placements: I am from the electronic and communication engineering course. Placements in our department are a bit low, and maybe like 7-10 students get placed out of around 70 students. We can't expect any big packages. Here, the salary package offered ranges from 4-6 LPA, which is the most common. One student got a package of 18 LPA, which is off-campus.
content.Infrastructure: There is no working Wi-Fi on campus. There is no Wi-Fi in hostels at all. Labs are average, but have enough equipment to run. Every classroom has a digital board, which is a good part of our campus. Desks are a little old. There is good medical support. It is also good for sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Excellent college in AP. We enjoy every bit of our time in this college.

content.Placements: Good placements. Top companies like Fanatics (18 LPA), Cognizant, Accenture, and Glory Global come. This year placements are a bit low due to recession and tough times for companies, but overall, placements are good (3.5/5). Many companies shortlist students based on CGPA.
content.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure is available for the department with 100 Mbps Wi-Fi. Faculty is exceptional. The principal and core principals are supportive. Labs and workshops are satisfactory for the Mechanical and Civil departments. A new computer lab is coming, and currently, we have four labs.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Review of College of Engineering, Sri Venkateswara University.

content.Placements: The placement percentage of my course is 90%. The highest package is 28 LPA. The average package is 6 LPA. The top companies include Amazon, Flipkart, Wipro, Infosys, etc. The percentage of getting internships is 75%. Companies like Wipro, etc, are visiting our college.
content.Infrastructure: The college looks very beautiful with its infrastructure. All blocks and department infrastructure are very beautiful with a cool climate. Wi-Fi is not available. Classrooms are good. The library is also good. Hostel rooms are very nice. The food gives a homey feeling. Overall, the food is superb. There are good facilities for medical and sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college is good. The infrastructure is very good.

content.Placements: The maximum of higher percentage of students get placed in placements in our college. The highest package is 18 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. Placements are slightly good, but not too much. In this college, teachers teach us about internships from the start.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very nice. There are digital classrooms. Hostels are also very nice. Our campus area is spread over 1000 acres of land. The atmosphere is good and full of greenery. This college has good infrastructure, and all are very adaptable.

placement_data.title: SVUCE Placement overview 2024
paragraphs: SVUCE placement record has been satisfactory with a placement percentage of 60 %. According to the students’ reviews on Shiksha, the highest salary package was INR 9 LPA while the lowest salary package was INR 4 LPA . Job roles included junior software engineers , App developers, Junior Engineers, and some startups also offer big roles. Top recruiting companies that took part in the placements were Wipro, Infosys, Tech Mahindra, Yatra, Cognizant, TCS and Accenture . The college has a placement cell which provides training, industry interaction programs, mentorship, lectures on career guidance and alumni connections. The placement cell also aids students in Internships. The highest stipend offered to the students was 10,000 rupees/month and the lowest was around 2500 rupees/month . Also, 4500 rupees /month was the average stipend offered during the internship.

The college is known for its food and placements. Additionally, discipline and other amenities like the canteen and medical facilities are basic; for other needs, we usually have to buy outside. Sports mainly focus on football, basketball, kabaddi, hockey, and ball badminton, as these games have more grounds in our college....

reviews.review_heading: The college is strict and will have decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good and pleasant. They provide Wi-Fi in labs, hostels, ideas, and innovation centers. The library is good and has a decent number of books. You can borrow books from the library for the semester exam preparation using a Bookbank card. One of the pros of this college is MESS. You will have to pay likely Rs. 1 lakh for food and transport. You can't avoid this fee. Whether you are a hostler or a scholar, you have to pay this. But will enjoy the good food. The sports are only ...

reviews.review_heading: High Placements, Exceptional Infrastructure and Culinary Delights!
reviews.review_text: The labs, classroom, library all are maintained well. They also provide wifi in labs, hostel. The food is minimum, 6 days non-veg in a week. But they ask minimum 1lakh for food. This is the best college for infrastructure, food, hostel . In hostel, they give 4 students per room. Football, Basketball, Volleyball, Kabaddi, Cricket grounds are in the college.

reviews.review_heading: This college will be good if you are okay with rules and regulations!
reviews.review_text: The labs, classrooms, library, and Wi-Fi are good. When it comes to the hostel, there are 4 students per room. The food is among the best in Tamil Nadu, but the fee is high as well! There is a dispensary in the college for medical emergencies, and sports facilities are available only for sports quota students. Don’t expect to play tournaments!

reviews.review_heading: Decent and good college for the students, but the placements are a disaster in the current year.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and the classrooms are okay. It is a good place to study and work hard. There is a strict system for the college students. The staff is worse for people to get a clear understanding of the concepts. You could join this college for the food because it is the only good thing here.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty and good placements.
reviews.review_text: I am really proud to study at St. Joseph Institute of Technology. The college infrastructure is really good and neat. Wife facilities are available in this college. Well-equipped labs. Classrooms are also very good. A library facility is also available. Toilets are also very neat and clean.

reviews.review_heading: Good college to join with 100% placement guarantee.
reviews.review_text: Facility and infrastructure are good in our college. Classrooms are well-maintained with good hygiene. The library is built with a large area where students help to gain knowledge and read all kinds of books regarding subjects and projects. Wi-Fi facility is also there for students to download subject-related books.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college in terms of academics.
reviews.review_text: Labs in our college are not excellent. There aren't adequate chairs. The chairs are faulty. We aren't allowed to use phones, so we do not have access to Wi-Fi unless the staff permits. The Wi-Fi speed is quite average. The classrooms are spacious, but the benches are a bit small.

reviews.review_heading: I'm dissatisfied with faculty members and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in our college are vast. Students are not allowed to use mobile phones on campus. Food and transport facilities are compulsory under academic fees.

reviews.review_heading: Our institute provides good placements.
reviews.review_text: We have a library with great books needed for our department. The hostel has Wi-Fi facilities and sports facilities. We have a cricket ground, a huge badminton court, and a volleyball court. The hostel food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of St. Joseph's Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is good, each room provides 4 students with non-air-conditioner. It also has a non-air-conditioner room with an attached washroom with a heater and room will be cleaned. Our hostel has a separate room for internet connection, and students can use the internet on the laptop by ethernet cables, and the internet speed is 50 Mbps to 100 Mbps.

reviews.review_heading: Review of St. Joseph's Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: It provides a building with all of the departments on each floor. The environment was very fresh. Hostels were convenient and more exclusive for students. A very big library was there with lots of knowledge. The laboratories provided were with advanced technology, and the students can easily learn things from them.

admission_overview.college_name: St. Joseph's College of Engineering Admission 2025: Courses, Eligibility, Dates & Application Process

paragraphs: St. Joseph College of Engineering admission is based on merit for some courses and on entrance exam scores for others.St. Joseph’s College of Engineeringis a private engineering college affiliated withAnna University, Chennai. The college offers degree programmes majorly in the field of engineering and technology. The college accepts national-level and state-level entrance exams, such as GATE, TANCET and TNEA. for admission to courses, namely MTech, MBA and BTech, respectively. St. Joseph College of Engineering offers four courses at undergraduate and postgraduate levels in the fields of Engineering, Technology and Management. Candidates can apply for admission online through the official website.

St. Joseph College of Engineering admission to most of the courses is based on the performance of the candidate in the entrance exam except for BBA. Admission to the SJCE BBA course is based on the merit secured by the candidate in the qualifying exam. Candidates, however, for all courses are required to meet minimum eligibility criteria to get shortlisted for any and every course offered by SJCE. Check below popularSJCE coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:

St. Joseph College of Engineering course admissions 2025 for all of its courses are either done based on merit or entrance exams. Check below the complete SJCE admission process:Application:The mode of application is online. Candidates must register online and then fill out the online application form.Selection rounds:If applying to the BTech, MTech or MBA course offered at the SJCE, then appear for the relevant entrance exam and then wait for the release of their results.

The college then shortlists candidates based on their performance in the entrance exam or merit in the qualifying examination.Admission confirmation:Once the selection rounds are done, the shortlisted candidates are called for document verification. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the college.

reviews.review_heading: The right path to our future.
reviews.review_text: The college has a sizable library with almost all the books we want. Canteens that offer delectable snacks at affordable prices, and smart boards that let students learn subjects through visual aids. Snacks cultivated and made on campus are more affordable. Students can get whatever they need at this college because it has the best facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I'm absolutely satisfied because of the seniors.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of our college are good, and the infrastructure looks very traditional, as well as innovative. They split the students into two types, one is HOPE, and the second is PEP. There is a library with many articles, and compared to other colleges, our college food is so good.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure, faculty members, and placements.
reviews.review_text: The college provides quality food, clean and well-maintained hostels. Spacious grounds that encourage students to engage in various sports and physical activities.

reviews.review_heading: Having a good experience at this college. It has good placements.
reviews.review_text: Our department is equipped with spacious classrooms, fully air-conditioned computer and research labs and high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the academic blocks. Campus also includes a well-stocked central library with digital access to journals and e-books relevant to our course. Smart boards and projectors are available in most classrooms to support interactive learning. The hostels offer good infrastructure with clean rooms, 24X7 water and electricity, and Wi-Fi access. The quality of food in the me...

reviews.review_heading: The college that makes my dream come true.
reviews.review_text: The department offers Wi-Fi connections, a modern lab with A/C facilities, a smart class is also there and they have a well-stocked library. Hostels are clean with basic amenities and the food provided in the mess is tasty. Also, they have canteen and the prices are very less compared to other canteens and good medical facilities. They also have an indoor and outdoor court to ensure the balance of the student.

reviews.review_heading: College has nice infrastructure and great faculty, but students still couldn't get enough exposure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good, with many facilities, and it is also easy to fit in quickly. The hostel infrastructure is not that great, because the rooms are not worth the fees we pay every year. It is a decent place to stay.

reviews.review_heading: My college is a bright future for the youth.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are available like Wi-Fi, 3 Labs, classrooms, library, smart classrooms, dispensary room, etc. Hostel is available with 24/7 Wi-Fi, good quality beds and pillows, twice daily room cleaning, laundry facilities, unlimited good-quality food, and a very large playing area.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with very high fees.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is okay. But the hostel infrastructure is very poor. A Wi-Fi facility is available in the hostel and college. The hostel's Wi-Fi is poor. In 1st year hostel, there is no space for air to come in. In the second-year hostel, the air is good.

reviews.review_heading: Good environment, but placements are good in the earlier stage. College is strict.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the department is good but the Wi-Fi facilities are weak. Labs and classrooms are good. In the classroom, there is no Wi-Fi. The network is also low. Library is good. The food is excellent. In our college, it's compulsory to pay fee for food. Canteen is not good. Medical facilities are available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Choose the best needed to become the best.
reviews.review_text: There will be canteen facilities, drinking water facilities, a gym, and a large library that consists of plenty of books for the hostel students, and even day scholars can opt for that. The quality of food is good, and there is special treatment for students opting for sports.

reviews.review_heading: Good food, strict rules, good placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is somewhat average since it is a 30-year-old college, but new buildings being constructed have some good infrastructure. Wi-Fi is available only in the hostel and lab; no Wi-Fi is available in classrooms. Labs are good with all the necessary equipment, and hostel food quality is also above average.

reviews.review_heading: The correct route to your future.
reviews.review_text: The college includes a large library with nearly all the books we need, canteens that serve delicious refreshments at a reasonable cost, and smart boards that allow students to learn topics visually. Snacks produced and grown on campus are offered at less money. With the best facilities, students may obtain all they need at this college.

reviews.review_heading: Best engineering college in Chennai.
reviews.review_text: The college provides Wi-Fi in all the labs, and each floor has a lab, so the Wi-Fi can reach the classrooms. Still mobile phones are not allowed. There is no canteen inside the college, but there is a stall that sells fries and noodles and a bakery that sells baked goods at very low prices.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for the people who follow rules and study well.
reviews.review_text: The college hostel is clean and neat, and the food is good compared to other colleges. The college has the best lab facilities. Still the mobile data signal is weak in the hostel and on campus.

reviews.review_heading: In our college, food, teaching, and infrastructure are too good.
reviews.review_text: I'm currently in the 1st year. The hostel is good, and the overall infrastructure is very nice. However, many people say our college is one of the strictest in Chennai. They are strict about dress code, lab activities, and speaking in English. The food here is like heaven.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My university has good infrastructure and has a Jain temple which is also very good.

content.Placements: I am pursuing B.A. LL.B. Hons. My batch is 2022 to 2027. There is no placement in the field of law at my university. 40 percent of students are placed in my course. Actually in my university there is no such package in Law. 5 to 10 percent of students got internships from my course such as NCLT, NALSA etc.
content.Infrastructure: In my department there are Wi-Fi facilities but sometimes they are working and sometimes they are not working. There are labs but only juniors have access to them. Classroom desk and chair are good. Library has a vast number of books. Food, medical and sports facilities are provided in my hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued (FEB 2026) B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Deep Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Mixed experience: good infrastructure, poor faculty, decent placements.

content.Placements: Percent of students placed: Around 70-80% of students from B.Teach AI and ML at TMU get placed. The highest, the lowest, and the average package offered:The highest package offered was around 12 LPA, the lowest was about 3 LPA, and the average package was approximately 6 LPA. - Top Recruiting Companies: Top recruiters include companies like Infosys, TCS, Wipro, and some startups in AI/ML. - Percent of students who got internships: About 50-60% of students got internships in companies like Teach Startups, IT firms, and research organizations. Top Roles Offered: Top roles include AI/ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Software Developer, and AI Consultant.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued (FEB 2026) Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: There are no good placements for finance and HR roles, but the faculty is good.

content.Placements: I got placed with the package of 5.4 LPA, but it was in sales. Most companies are for sale. The top recruiter is Wipro. 30-40% of students get the offer letter. We have to look for the internships ourselves, and mostly job roles, even from top recruiters, were from Salem.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, but Wi-Fi doesn't work, and library books are not updated. Only 1 canteen, but the food is tasty. Parking problems for cars and no open area to play. The campus is small, so there is no campus life in TMIMT. Generally, there are no sports classes.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College campus is very good and eco-friendly.

content.Placements: College offers strong placement support with top recruiters like TCS, Infosys and Wipro. Regular training, mock interviews and internship opportunities help students gain confidence and industry exposure. Many students get placed in reputed firms.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is top notch with smart classrooms, modern labs and a digital library. Hostels are well-maintained, Wi-Fi-enabled and offer hygienic food. We have common rooms and study spaces that create a student friendly environment for both living and learning.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Optometry (B.Optom.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: In 2025, good placement, really good infrastructure, and facilities are available.

content.Placements: About 75% of students get placed in the course. The package is Rs 23,000 per month to Rs 45,000 per month. Recruiting companies are Lenskart, Titan Eye Care, AIMS, Eye 7, and CL Gupta. 90% of students got internships. Top roles offered are optometrist, ophthalmic assistant, vision therapist, optical sales consultant, etc. It also provides international opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities are good. Infrastructure is also available. Every day 2 hour lab is compulsory. Classrooms are neat and clean. All books are available in library. Everything is available in hostel and students enjoy like home. Every day different type of food is served.

admission_overview.college_name: TMU Course Admission 2025: Dates, Fee, Eligibility & Selection Criteria

paragraphs: Teerthanker Mahaveer University admission 2025 is open.TMU admission is both merit and entrance-based.The university accepts national-level entrance exams like CUET-UG, JEE Main, UPCET, etc.,for admission to specific courses. TMU offers 50+ courses at UG, PG, and doctoral levels in multiple streams likeEngineering,Management,Commerce, Law, Education, etc.

Candidates seeking admission toTMU coursesmust meet the course-specific eligibility criteria and go through the selection process determined by the University. The general eligibility for TMU UG courses is that the candidates must have passed class 12 or equivalent with relevant subjects. Additionally, the minimum requirement for PG courses is graduation. Check below the TMU course eligibility and selection criteria for some of the top courses:
Class 12 with Physics, Maths & Chemistry (or Computer Science) with a minimum of 50% aggregate and passing marks in English
JEE Main/UPCET/ Merit-based
Class 12 with at least 50% aggregate in PCB and pass marks in English
Graduation in any stream with at least 50% aggregate
MAT/CAT/CMAT/ merit-based + PI
Class 12 with Mathematics at Class 10 level with at least 50% aggregate
Merit-based/ CUET-UG
Merit-based/ CUET-UG (for all except BSc Medical)
Merit-based/ CUET-UG
Class 12 in any stream with at least 50% aggregate
To check out the admission process for other UG & PG courses,make your course selection here.
*This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

Teerthanker Mahaveer University fees range fromINR 20,000 to INR 70 lakh. The fees vary as per the TMU-affiliated colleges. TMU offers a limited number of seats for its offered programme. The programme is offered via its affiliated college as well. Tabulated below are the TMU fees and seats for the academic year
*This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

TMU follows a multistep admission process determined by the University. The aspirants must begin their TMU admission process by meeting the course-specific eligibility criteria, followed by filling out the application form. After the application process is completed, aspirants are required to go through the predetermined selection criteria, based on which the university shortlists candidates for final admission.
The complete step-wiseTMU admission processis given below:

TMU Application Process:The TMU application process is conductedonline on the official websiteof the university. Candidates can either apply directly through the official website or they can download the application form from the website and mail the duly filled form with relevant documents to admissions@tmu.ac.in.

TMU Selection Process:The TMU admission criteria are merit-based for some courses and entrance-based for others. Based on the selection criteria determined by the University, a merit list is prepared, containing the names of shortlisted candidates, and published on theTMU official website.
TMU Admission Confirmation:Selected candidates are required to pay the admission confirmation fee and appear for the document verification process to confirm their submission.
