hostel.description:
The University houses five hostels in its campus- 2 for boys and 3 for girls with a capacity to accommodate 4600 students.The hostel rooms are spacious, clean, and well maintained with attached bathrooms. The rooms are available on single occupancy basis as well as on sharing basis. To help the young minds focus on their studies, each room is furnished with beds, wardrobes, study tables, chairs and air-cooler. Solar heaters have been installed in all the hostels to supply hot water conserving electricity. Water purifiers and water coolers are installed to provide potable water. Round the clock power back-up helps students to study without interruption.

Air-conditioned rooms are also available to meet specific requirement of the students. Each hostel has a visitor’s room, a spacious well lit common room with a large screen television and comfortable seating arrangement, recreational facilities, equipments for indoor games, newspapers and magazines, Wi-Fi connectivity and a gymnasium. Laundry facility is available in-house with commercial washing machine and tumbler drier. Spacious dining rooms and modern kitchens ensure that students are served with nutritious food in a good ambiance.

A dedicated team of wardens and caretakers helps and resolve the problems of the boarders. Students are advised to comply with rules and regulations of the University hostels.

library.description:
The central library was established in the year 2008, it is situated on the fifth floor of the Medical College & Research Centre and occupies 2560 sq. m. area along with Central library, and University maintains well stocked separate libraries for each of its colleges and faculties. 

These libraries have more than one lakh books on varied subjects and have subscription to print version of 396 national and international journals besides access to a host of e-journals. 

The University has subscribed the ClinicalKey, DELNET, EBSCOhost and maupatra data base providing access to full text research articles and sector specific reports in different disciplines.

review_content.Placements: Around 80-85% of students get placed in this course. The highest package is 40 LPA for ECE and 1.3 crores for CSE. The average package is 13 LPA with a median of 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Samsung, BNY, Adobe, and MakeMyTrip. I do my first internship as a first-year student in a data analytics role in a company in offline mode. In my course, most students get placed, some in core and some in tech-related jobs. ECE is diverse and divided into various domains like robotics, AI/ML, automation, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The department infrastructure is good, and a new building solely for AI is under development. Wi-Fi and LAN facilities are available. Labs are well-equipped and have industry-based software and hardware. The library has three halls and a separate hall with PCs. It also has a noise-cancellation media room for shoots. Hostel facilities are average. Boys’ Hostel 4 has ACs and other facilities, but other hostels lack proper renovation and amenities. The quality of food is good compared to other colleges. The canteen area is small with limited options. Medical facilities are free for all and available 24/7.

review_summary.college_name: LNMIIT Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Fine college to take admission if you want a good campus and facilities.

content.Placements: My batch was fine, i.e., Y23. The placements were average. The thing is, the college provides 100 percent placement on the website, but only some of the students are applicable to sit on placements. It does not include those who are not applicable, whose CGPA is less. And don't expect ECE core companies; there are too few.
content.Infrastructure: When it comes to the hostels, the college is pretty good. Hostel BH4 is newly built and even has AC facilities and is in new condition. Facility-wise, the college is decent. Wi-Fi is available in every hostel; one girls' hostel is there, and there are five boys' hostels, including one more newly built hostel, which is small, BH5.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Communication and Computer Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of LNM Institute of Information Technology.

content.Placements: The placements are decent, the average package right now is 10 LPA, which is good. We do have on-campus placements, and we have a dedicated training and placement cell, but overall, the average package has dropped, as it was around 14 LPA in 2022, but now it is just 10 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at college is good, we have all sorts of labs, and we have enough hostels for students, but most of the hostels are not well maintained. Other issues are water disruption on a weekly basis, and only a few hostels have Wi-Fi facilities. We have air ducts in most of the hostels and AC in some.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: LNMIIT is worth the fee.

content.Placements: Around 80-85% of students get placed in this course. The highest package is 40 LPA for ECE and 1.3 crores for CSE. The average package is 13 LPA with a median of 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Samsung, BNY, Adobe, and MakeMyTrip. I do my first internship as a first-year student in a data analytics role in a company in offline mode. In my course, most students get placed, some in core and some in tech-related jobs. ECE is diverse and divided into various domains like robotics, AI/ML, automation, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The department infrastructure is good, and a new building solely for AI is under development. Wi-Fi and LAN facilities are available. Labs are well-equipped and have industry-based software and hardware. The library has three halls and a separate hall with PCs. It also has a noise-cancellation media room for shoots. Hostel facilities are average. Boys’ Hostel 4 has ACs and other facilities, but other hostels lack proper renovation and amenities. The quality of food is good compared to other colleges. The canteen area is small with limited options. Medical facilities are free for all and available 24/7.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is good, but it comes with a cost.

content.Placements: This year, 92 percent of students got placed. The highest package is more than 1 crore off campus, the average is 13.8 LPA, and the lowest is 12.2 LPA. Google came to our college to recruit students. The main internship is off-campus, so we don't know much. Top roles offered are software developer, blockchain architect, and many more. As I don't know much, but some people got a post in finance also.
content.Infrastructure: Well, the academic area, library, and labs are clean and maintained with the best equipment and supplies. The hostels are good with internet, but we have to clean our rooms ourselves. Mess food is good, but this hostel is in a forest, so there are many animals and insects to be aware of.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and college life.

content.Placements: As placement year has just started and it's just the start only, already 240 students are placed out of around 450 students, and I am talking about on-campus placement. Still, there is the whole year left, so I think it's a very good number. In this college, getting an on-campus placement is easy because competition is less since the number of students in a batch is only 600–650, and around 500 sit for the placement.
content.Infrastructure: It's quite good, like you have all the basic requirements, but wardens are quite strict, which is a downgrade. Otherwise, everything is good, and the food is also good compared to other colleges. Wi-Fi is good, the speed is very good, but we have to log in again and again every 3 hours.

reviews.review_heading: Fine college to take admission if you want a good campus and facilities.
reviews.review_text: When it comes to the hostels, the college is pretty good. Hostel BH4 is newly built and even has AC facilities and is in new condition. Facility-wise, the college is decent. Wi-Fi is available in every hostel; one girls' hostel is there, and there are five boys' hostels, including one more newly built hostel, which is small, BH5.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LNM Institute of Information Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at college is good, we have all sorts of labs, and we have enough hostels for students, but most of the hostels are not well maintained. Other issues are water disruption on a weekly basis, and only a few hostels have Wi-Fi facilities. We have air ducts in most of the hostels and AC in some.

reviews.review_heading: LNMIIT is worth the fee.
reviews.review_text: The department infrastructure is good, and a new building solely for AI is under development. Wi-Fi and LAN facilities are available. Labs are well-equipped and have industry-based software and hardware. The library has three halls and a separate hall with PCs. It also has a noise-cancellation media room for shoots. Hostel facilities are average. Boys’ Hostel 4 has ACs and other facilities, but other hostels lack proper renovation and amenities. The quality of food is good compared to other coll...

reviews.review_heading: College is good, but it comes with a cost.
reviews.review_text: Well, the academic area, library, and labs are clean and maintained with the best equipment and supplies. The hostels are good with internet, but we have to clean our rooms ourselves. Mess food is good, but this hostel is in a forest, so there are many animals and insects to be aware of.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and college life.
reviews.review_text: It's quite good, like you have all the basic requirements, but wardens are quite strict, which is a downgrade. Otherwise, everything is good, and the food is also good compared to other colleges. Wi-Fi is good, the speed is very good, but we have to log in again and again every 3 hours.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for CS for 97-98 percent in JEE Main.
reviews.review_text: Central library is top-notch in terms of the study environment it provides, and the vast availability of all course related books. Only con is that it shuts down at 10:00 PM. In boys hostel, 4 rooms are spacious and common areas are also clean most of the time. Wi-Fi speed is good but you need to login after 3 hours every time so it gets a little annoying.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the infrastructure, events, and academics.
reviews.review_text: LNMIIT Jaipur offers good quality facilities. The infrastructure is also well-maintained. The quality of Wi-Fi that is offered in the college and hostel is very good. The speed of the Wi-Fi is approximately 150 Mbps. Labs in our college are very clean, hygienic, and well-maintained. Classrooms are very clean, well-furnished, and very huge. The library facility offered by our college is very good and well-furnished, and includes various types of books. We have different genres of books as well. T...

reviews.review_heading: Good placements tough academics great college life and great exposure decent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are great in this college with great labs and a very good central library. The classes are also decent with good Air conditioning but only 2 out of 5 hostels are good. The hostel facility is old like the most famous hostel and the best hostel on campus is BH4 with a TT table and a badminton net with a night canteen and a mess inside. They started a laundry system in 2025 otherwise the other hostels are just not worth the hype, other hostels are like a jail with no AC.

reviews.review_heading: Academic pressure, infrastructure, and fees.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure here is below average. Water gets logged in corridors even after a drizzle. Lecture theaters are old and still have green boards and projectors. First-level medical facilities are nice and available every time. Mess food is edible. Wi-Fi is provided everywhere, but you need to log in again every 3 hours. The AI center building is under construction and hopefully will be something of its own.

reviews.review_heading: LNMIIT: Fests of a private college but facilities of a government college.
reviews.review_text: By a private college level, the college facility is below par. The labs, classrooms, and library are good, though I would say the library is small for the number of admissions. Hostels are very bad. The duct system does not give any cooling, and washrooms are always dirty, the gym is very small, so it is always crowded, and machines are also not in working condition.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities are not up to the mark according to the fees which we pay.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not present in some hostels, but they provide LAN facility. Labs are nice, they have AC and good systems. Classrooms are good. Libraries are great, they have almost every book you need, with a great sitting area, and you can issue any book you want. The main food quality is not up to the mark compared to the fees. Good sports facilities like basketball, volleyball, and almost every sport are present. They have a good medical facility or medical room and provide medicine for diseases. Th...

reviews.review_heading: Great placement opportunities but disappointing facilities and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not available in one hostel, but they provide LAN connectivity. Facilities are good. Labs have great systems and AC. Classrooms are fine. The library is very good, with nice seating, well-managed, and has all kinds of books. In some hostels, AC and Wi-Fi are available, while others have duct and LAN ports. Sports are great. Almost every sport is present in the college. The gym is also there. Mess food is not up to the mark compared to the fees they charge. They have a decent medical fac...

reviews.review_heading: LNMIIT Jaipur is a great college with some minor faults at its core.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities in my college were below average in BH-1,2,3. The best hostel at my campus is BH-4, in which we had proper air conditioning with good space in rooms, along with Wi-Fi Connections available on all 6 floors, but other hostels did not have AC, while they have ducts which do not work as well as AC but do the work.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and decent placements with supportive faculty
reviews.review_text: Well-equipped classrooms, decent-speed Wi-Fi, a modern lab, and a central library with both physical and digital resources. Hostels are comfortable with basic amenities. The mess provides hygienic and decent food, and there are canteens for extra options. Medical facilities are available on campus, along with sports grounds and courts for physical activities.

reviews.review_heading: A very satisfactory experience. The campus is also expanding.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very decent compared to other colleges. Central AC facilities and some hostels even have AC facilities. Sports ground for football, cricket, basketball courts, jogging track, etc. The food is also very decent and the campus is covered with greenery all around making it a serene environment to walk in. Classrooms and libraries are also very comfortable to study in.

review_summary.college_name: Uttaranchal University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is excellent as it helps us achieve our dreams.

content.Placements: Students are placed in various companies such as Wipro, Deloitte, HCL, Tech Mahindra, TCS, and many more. The highest package is 1.24 crores, the lowest package is 2.4 LPA, and the average package is 4 LPA. About 55% of students get internships at companies like Codetech and Wipro. The top roles offered in my course are web developer, app developer, and cybersecurity.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities are available in classrooms and laboratories, including lab assistants, good Wi-Fi, and a neat and clean environment. The campus is very clean. In the hostel, all basic facilities are provided, such as a table, an almirah, a shoe rack, a chair, a fan, a water cooler, and a geyser. The food quality in the mess is good, but sometimes it is not that good. Medical facilities are available 24/7 as there is a hospital on the campus. Sports are held 2–3 times a year.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. with ACCA Certification Course - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college.

content.Placements: Many students get placed in my course, so I cannot say the exact number. The highest package offered, as per my knowledge, is 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are HSBC, Amazon, Infosys, Citibank, Deloitte, KPMG, and EY. 60 percent of students get internships from my course. Roles like financial analyst, auditor, and global chartered accountant are offered.
content.Infrastructure: Network stability is too low. I give it 2 stars. Labs are clean and very peaceful. Classrooms are well-maintained and comfortable. The library has many collections of books, and we can take books from there according to our mindset. I do not stay in the hostel, so I do not know about it.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: UIT, B.Tech course in specialization of AI and ML.

content.Placements: The total percentage of students placed from the college last year, 2024 was around 75%. The average package offered in B.Tech computer science course is around 5 LPA. Many recruiting companies come, specially for the students who have specialisation in AI and ML as this is a demanding branch that's why the starting package of these courses are way too high. Try to get up in more competitions, such as hackathons or any other coding challenges through which there are high chances to get placed.
content.Infrastructure: The college has given all the required facilities to the student, so that they don't have to go out of campus for getting something. The marketplace is also provided in college area. The medical facilities are also up to the mark in case of any emergency happens to students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: B.Tech course at Uttarachal University.

content.Placements: The college has many positive reviews regarding placements. The college provides a good balance between academics and extracurricular activities. It also focuses on group discussions. Many other sessions that helps during placements. Regular workshops are also conducted by guest faculty members.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is properly made with well-maintained classrooms having proper ventilation. The classroom size is around 80 students. Hostel facilities are decent, with rooms having furniture. There is proper security with an allotted warden for each hostel.

hostel.description: The hostel of Uttaranchal University has a provision for the single room, double room, three bed and four-bedroom. Each room is furnished with bed/beds, mattress, study table, chair, cupboard and curtains. 4000 boys and girls can accommodate in the campus hostel. There are spacious lawns within the hostel campus for the students to play different games or to take walk or recreate themselves. Great care is taken to maintain hygienic conditions and cleanliness. Hostel common rooms are fully equipped with HD TV network, indoor games, newspapers and laundry staff. There is a separate group of hostel maintenance staff under the active supervision of the Chief Warden. The hostel offers many exciting experiences both in the terms of games and entertainment.

library.description: The Uttaranchal University’s library holds a hybrid collection of 125000 books, 125 current periodicals, 1000 back volumes, 15 National newspapers, 1000+ e-journals and e-books of National / International societies  500+ dissertations and over 2500 CDs/DVDs.  The bibliographical details and content pages for all the books are accessible through OPAC. The Library has a collection of approximately 3500 clippings concerning to topics relevant to the academic community of the University. The Library has a multimedia section to access NPTEL video lectures on various subjects and topics.

reviews.review_heading: It is excellent as it helps us achieve our dreams.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available in classrooms and laboratories, including lab assistants, good Wi-Fi, and a neat and clean environment. The campus is very clean. In the hostel, all basic facilities are provided, such as a table, an almirah, a shoe rack, a chair, a fan, a water cooler, and a geyser. The food quality in the mess is good, but sometimes it is not that good. Medical facilities are available 24/7 as there is a hospital on the campus. Sports are held 2–3 times a year.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college.
reviews.review_text: Network stability is too low. I give it 2 stars. Labs are clean and very peaceful. Classrooms are well-maintained and comfortable. The library has many collections of books, and we can take books from there according to our mindset. I do not stay in the hostel, so I do not know about it.

reviews.review_heading: UIT, B.Tech course in specialization of AI and ML.
reviews.review_text: The college has given all the required facilities to the student, so that they don't have to go out of campus for getting something. The marketplace is also provided in college area. The medical facilities are also up to the mark in case of any emergency happens to students.

reviews.review_heading: B.Tech course at Uttarachal University.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is properly made with well-maintained classrooms having proper ventilation. The classroom size is around 80 students. Hostel facilities are decent, with rooms having furniture. There is proper security with an allotted warden for each hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good hostel & events, average academics, and placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is value for money, and the food in the mess is quite good. Breakfast, lunch, and snacks are well prepared, though dinner could be better. Canteen food is average. Wi-Fi is available 24/7, but in some areas, the connectivity is not very stable. Medical facilities are provided, and in the evening, students enjoy playing cricket and football on the ground. The only drawback of the hostel is that the warden tends to be too strict. All the academic buildings are equipped with well maintai...

reviews.review_heading: UIT College, Dehradun for the course B.Teach.
reviews.review_text: I like the college campus very much as it is so huge, surrounded by so much land with all the facilities. There are many cafeterias or food courts in the college itself. There are many sports and game facilities in the college for the students who are very fond of sports. Other than this, the college also conducts many seminars or functions at least once in two weeks to gain engagement among students.

reviews.review_heading: University for B.Tech AI/Ml.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is highly admirable and well-maintained with proper cleanliness and all the facilities required by the students. Most of the facilities are provided by the college in the tuition and hostel fees themselves. There are no additional charges for them. Other than this, there are sports facilities through which you can play lots of games in inter-college competitions.

reviews.review_heading: For B.Tech, it is the best preference.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and the department buildings are very good and spacious. The college also has many built-in facilities, such as a library for each course, Wi-Fi, which is available all the time. In addition to this, the college also has its own temple. The seniors of the college are also very helpful and nice.

reviews.review_heading: Brief review about my college.
reviews.review_text: The college is excellent in terms of infrastructure, including the classrooms, libraries, and other resources that enhance the learning experience and student experience of getting into a great college.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very good for students because it also provides an EMI option.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are like a good environment, activities, library, computer classes, trips, free Wi-Fi, and more. Hostel facilities are very good, like food quality, cleanliness is good, and more. In hostel, rooms are very hygienic and beautiful, and the outdoor view is awesome.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college. It has good placements, good facilities, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very nice. The infrastructure is excellent. The quality of food is okay. For sports, there is a high demand. We have a huge ground to play. It conducts competitions, programs, events, etc. It is the best college. Not only in my course, but in all the courses, it has the best facilities. We have a huge library to read, understand, and explain. We can enjoy reading and learning more.

reviews.review_heading: Greatest campus life in Dehradun with top-class fests, decent placements, and supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: The department offers smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, high-speed Wi-Fi and both physical and e-library access, all maintained at an A+ level. The hostels are clean and well-maintained with 24/7 Wi-Fi and basic amenities. Mess food is hygienic, and the canteen offers a good variety. There are on-campus medical facilities and excellent sports infrastructure for both indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is really great.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, and classrooms are also good. The library is excellent. It has 4 courses and 24x7 medical care. The hostel feels like home. The food is really great. Especially, in girls hostel, the safety is up to the mark as 24x7 guards are available. Girls are allowed to visit outside the campus only once.

reviews.review_heading: Decent infrastructure and campus.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are very clean, with great infrastructure of rooms and a great infrastructure of college, and the hostels are within the campus, so it is easy for all the students to reach the department easily. Also, the wardens and hostel staff are very supportive.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges for pursuing the B.A. in Journalism and Mass Communication course.

There is no other TV Lab in Dehradun, but it has got such a lab, which includes Mac systems, controller console switchers, teleprompter, EP, radio labs, photos labs, Panasonic 4K cameras, 80D, and the freedom to use it all with permission for whatever creative work we intend to do with it. review_content.General: My department had decent Wi-Fi, well-maintained labs, and classrooms with projectors. The library was helpful for reference books and quiet study. reviews_list.review_title: You can go to this college only if your EAMCENT rank is low or if you are going for management seat.

The highest package is around 24 LPA, the lowest package is around 2 LPA, and the average package in this college is around 6 LPA-7 LPA. Recruiting companies such as Microsoft, Accenture, Tata, etc. 35%-45% of students offered internship opportunities. CSE, ECE, EEE, and specializations in CSE are the top roles offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities in this college are quite impressive. For every course, there is a certified faculty. The Wi-Fi of the college provides good and fast internet to compile code faster. Labs look quite impressive and professional. Classrooms provide ventilation to each class. There are multiple libraries that students can access easily. The main disappointment is that there is no hostel in this college. Though they are building it now, it may be completed in the year 2027. Every year, they conduct a sports fest. We play with other colleges and also among ourselves.

Facilities provided by the hostel were also great for students, with good and neat rooms and tasty food available in the canteen and mess at reasonable prices. Games like cricket, volleyball, and basketball were played regularly in the college. The medical facilities were available throughout the day.

review_summary.college_name: Vidya Jyothi Institute of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and campus life and good faculty support but limited placement opportunities.

content.Placements: Good placements. 8 CGPA. The lowest package 5 LPA and the highest 20 LPA. VJIT’s placements are decent but moderate compared to top-tier colleges. Students with solid skills often secure better packages, especially IT roles. Average packages cluster around 4 to 5 LPA, while few students secure higher offers up to 10 to 12 LPA or more.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are good, neat, and clean. Library, classrooms, Wi-Fi, and ACs available. Spacious, well-laid campus. VJIT sits on a 10+ acre green campus with landscaped grounds and modern academic buildings. Infrastructure is good to above average for academic support, practical learning, recreation, and student services.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Affordable course with supportive faculty and active campus life.

content.Placements: Around 65-70% of students in my course got placed. The highest package was about 8- 9 LPA, the average stayed near 3.5- 4 LPA, and the lowest was around 2.5 LPA. Recruiters included TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Teach Mahindra, Capgemini and a few startups. Nearly 40% of students got internships from companies like BSNL, TCS iON and local IT firms. The common roles offered were Software Trainee, Embedded Intern, QA Analyst and Network Support Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: My department had decent Wi-Fi, well-maintained labs, and classrooms with projectors. The library was helpful for reference books and quiet study. The hostel facilities were average but manageable, with regular cleaning and basic amenities. Mess food was simple and sometimes repetitive, but the canteen offered better options. We had a small medical room for basic issues, and the campus had grounds for cricket, volleyball, and indoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: You can go to this college only if your EAMCENT rank is low or if you are going for management seat.

content.Placements: 80%-90% of students got placed from this college. The highest package is around 24 LPA, the lowest package is around 2 LPA, and the average package in this college is around 6 LPA-7 LPA. Recruiting companies such as Microsoft, Accenture, Tata, etc. 35%-45% of students offered internship opportunities. CSE, ECE, EEE, and specializations in CSE are the top roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities in this college are quite impressive. For every course, there is a certified faculty. The Wi-Fi of the college provides good and fast internet to compile code faster. Labs look quite impressive and professional. Classrooms provide ventilation to each class. There are multiple libraries that students can access easily. The main disappointment is that there is no hostel in this college. Though they are building it now, it may be completed in the year 2027. Every year, they conduct a sports fest. We play with other colleges and also among ourselves.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Our college had the best faculty and staff, and there were many facilities as well.

content.Placements: Almost 70 percent of students from our course got placed in campus placements in top companies. The highest package was 5.5 LPA, the average package was 3 LPA, and the lowest package was 2.5 LPA. The top recruiting companies included Foxconn, COULRYT, and 24/7 AI. Approximately 53 percent of students completed their internships in companies like Software IT Solutions and Arky Technology Pvt. Ltd. The top roles were Network Planning Engineer and Electronic Design Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college was absolutely satisfying for students. Facilities were very reasonable. Facilities included AC labs, seminar halls, a library, free Wi-Fi around the entire campus, and other resources. Facilities provided by the hostel were also great for students, with good and neat rooms and tasty food available in the canteen and mess at reasonable prices. Games like cricket, volleyball, and basketball were played regularly in the college. The medical facilities were available throughout the day.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I literally loved this college because of faculty members and staff.

content.Placements: The placements were excellent in our college from our course. Approximately 73 percent of the students got placed in the campus placements. The highest package was 7 LPA, the average package was 5 LPA, and the lowest package was 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies like TCS, Wipro, and Accenture participated. Approximately 67 percent of the students received their internship certificates from our course. The top roles included software development and code development.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities were really satisfactory for students at reasonable prices. Facilities included separate blocks for different branches, AC classrooms, library, free Wi-Fi across the campus, auditorium, and seminar halls. The mess and canteen food were excellent with decent prices. Medical services were also good. Professional doctors available. Sports and games were conducted every weekend, with sports meets organized regularly.

reviews.review_heading: Short review of WCE Sangli.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available in the college like Wi-Fi but the infrastructure is old. West Maharashtras largest library is in a college. The hostel facility is not available for all students. Semester exams are very strict; in every classroom, 2 to 3 cameras are set up. Mid sem exam continuing 30 marks, internal exams continuing 20 marks, and end sem exam continuing 50 marks. For passing, an overall 40 marks out of 100 are necessary, and in the end sem 20 are necessary.

reviews.review_heading: Huge green campus, helpful seniors, no ragging, clubs, competition, and respectful students.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available 24X7 in library, classrooms, hostels, study room, and on campus too. Labs are conducted in their respective departments. College has very big campus with separate departments and an academic complex for classes and theory lectures. In hostel, we have 4 sharing rooms and 2 shared rooms for NRI. There are playground, jogging track, a mess, and gym as well.

reviews.review_heading: I would rate 8 out of 10 for it. WCE will provide us with a great platform.
reviews.review_text: The college has great classrooms with all digital screens. Wi-Fi facility is available all over the campus. The central library is available for students from 9 AM to 9 PM while the study room is available 24x7. Hostel rooms and mess are average. We prefer to mess outside the campus. There are two grounds for students, i.e., the main ground and the hostel ground. Many sports competitions are arranged for students throughout the year.

reviews.review_text: Walchand College of Engineering offers B.Tech, M.Tech, and Ph.D. courses in branches like Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer, and IT. The campus has separate boys' and girls. Hostels with Wi-Fi, mess, and study facilities at reasonable annual fees.

reviews.review_text: All required facilities are available in hostels, such as filtered drinking water, fresh water, and 24/7 neat and clean washrooms. All necessary working labs are available there with the proper working electronics required for the course. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Hidden Gem of Maharashtra: Outstanding placements and excellent event culture - WCE Sangli.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus life, good placements, and supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college provides excellent Wi-Fi connectivity, well-equipped computer labs, smart classrooms, and a large central library with access to digital journals. The hostel rooms are spacious and well-maintained with 24/7 water and electricity. The mess food is decent and hygienic. There are separate facilities for sports, gym, and medical care. The canteen food is affordable and offers multiple cuisines.

reviews.review_heading: The college is great for engineering.
reviews.review_text: The hostel here is very small. The rooms are very small, and everyone has to share one common washroom for activities like bathing and using restrooms.
